# spawn behavior in xpcom/rust/moz_task/src/executor.rs

Creates a default builder and starts a Send future on the background pool.

## State read

- name, future

## State changed

- new task through builder

## Calls and triggers

- TaskBuilder::new(...).spawn(); builder bodies read above.

## Result and consumers

AsyncTask<F::Output>; completion means future returned its output, not just dispatch accepted.

## Errors

Underlying dispatch failure is logged; cancelled task may remain Pending. 

## Async completion

Schedules immediately; wrapper supports await, detach and cancellation. May-block is a hint, not proof of I/O pool selection.

## Ownership and cleanup

Moves future to async task; target RefPtr retained for onto variants.
